description.value:
The Hōzuki clan's kekkei genkai: you convert your entire body into water for a short time. While hydrified, you have resistance 10 to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, fire, and electricity damage, but weakness 5 to cold damage and a vulnerability to absorbent or sealing effects (the GM may rule certain seals trap you outright).

You can squeeze through any opening at least 1 inch wide and you gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. You cannot wield non-water-natured weapons effectively (treat as Athletics DC 20 to hold or use any solid object).

The jutsu lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. Re-solidifying takes a single action.

Heightened (+2) Resistance increases by 5; the cold weakness threshold rises by 2 ranks of cold-trait incoming spell to bypass.

system.requirements: you have the Hydrification kekkei genkai
